reasons.orphan|figure.study-art: On /research/ at 359–436 px (eight measured widths), the 90px-wide identity drawing is top-aligned beside the two-line title and named-author credit. Its roughly 84px height fills 49% of the 173px heading/credit group. The instrument records 88px below the drawing, which sits beside continuing text; it is not an empty full-width spacer. Keep the compact cue and legible title/credit: enlarging the drawing to fill that height would create decorative demand.
reasons.dead|figcaption: On /memory/, the default first-room drawing is 120×160px (3:4) at the 29 measured widths from 849 to 1920px. Its number/joke caption is about 69px tall and top-aligned beside the drawing, leaving 91px alongside its lower part. The compact scene remains legible as the recall cue; this is space beside that meaningful image, not an empty full-width spacer. The picture, its meaning and the recall action fit together in the first screen. Do not enlarge the drawing or stretch the caption to manufacture equal heights.
reasons.dead|div.route-number.mono: On /bible/, each compact number marks reading order beside a chapter heading and its variable-length summary. The number stays aligned with the heading; the remaining gutter sits beside the continuing summary. There is no connector line on this guide. On /rights/, the top-aligned numbers are joined by a hairline timeline: the space below each marker carries the connector to the next rights topic. Neither surface stretches its number to fill the text column.
